content:
Follow-up to PR #12 (phase-11-acceptance-fixes, approved r2), from the BOWIE verify run: https://github.com/jblacketter/bugalizer/pull/12#issuecomment-5965410207 (`gh api repos/jblacketter/bugalizer/issues/comments/5965410207`). That comment is the spec. Uncommitted on branch fix/interrupted-sync-evidence off main a9b4078; review with `git diff`.

Finding 1 (P1, a regression from the r2 change I wrote): `release_orphaned_claims` fails a `running` triage row as `{interrupted: true}` and keeps its `trigger_ref`. Sync recovery's `evidence()` (sync/actions.py) took any failed tagged row as a finished run, so an interrupted analyze_local ended `failed` ("ran and failed") instead of re-running. That broke acceptance step 8 on BOWIE.
- Fix: a new `_finished_rows(action_id)` drops rows whose `result.interrupted` is true. `evidence()` uses it for analyze_local and for the fix-failure lookup. An interrupted attempt is now treated like a row still `running`: free work re-runs, and paid work (`no_auto_retry`) gets `unconfirmed_failure`, never re-dispatch. Today the startup release does not tag the interrupted fix row, so the fix branch changes nothing now. It is defensive and consistent.

Finding 2 (P3, Windows-only test failure): `_now()` stamps stored timestamps up to a few µs ahead of the raw clock, while eligibility compares them against raw `datetime.now()`. With `retry_delay=0`, elapsed came out at -2 µs and blocked the report. Fix: clamp `elapsed = max(0.0, …)` in `triage_eligible_reports` and `_retry_blocked`. With the production 60 s delay this changes nothing.

Tests (3 new; all 3 fail against main's db.py/actions.py and pass here):
- `test_an_interrupted_analyze_local_is_rerun_after_startup_release`: dispatched analyze_local, report `analyzing`, a running triage row tagged with the action. Release, restart, recover. Expect the local stage re-run once and the action `done`. This is the "release, then sync recovery" case the comment says r2 did not cover.
- `test_an_interrupted_analyze_cloud_is_unconfirmed_not_rerun`: paid action, `fix_proposing`, and an interrupted fix row that does carry the tag. Expect no stage call and "could not be confirmed". Before the fix it read "The fix proposal failed".
- `test_a_failure_stamped_just_ahead_of_the_clock_is_not_inside_a_zero_delay`: a failed row stamped 5 ms ahead with delay 0 is still eligible (triage list and `_retry_blocked`). This reproduces the Windows mechanism on any OS. The Windows-failing test itself passes on macOS, so I could not watch it go red here.

full suite: 439 passed, 0 skipped @ a9b4078 + working tree (macOS; gate off, this is the run on record). Not run on Windows.

Out of scope (the comment's side notes): no token_usage row for a cut-off paid call (known gap), and project llm_model overrides.

Approved at main a9b4078 plus the submitted working-tree changes in db.py, sync/actions.py, tests/test_queue.py and tests/test_triage_sync.py. Read the BOWIE verification comment (5965410207), the full diff, and the recovery decision path. No blocking findings.

The evidence filter correctly excludes interrupted attempts without deleting their failed rows or weakening worker retry accounting. An interrupted analyze_local can re-dispatch; paid actions still reach no_auto_retry and report an unconfirmed outcome without another call. Completed localization/proposal evidence and ordinary non-interrupted failures retain their previous handling. The elapsed-time clamp fixes zero-delay eligibility for slightly future timestamps while preserving positive retry delays and retry caps.

Verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_queue.py tests/test_triage_sync.py — 88 passed. Accepted the reported full suite of 439 passed, 0 skipped at a9b4078 plus this working tree; did not rerun it. Windows/BOWIE deployment and acceptance step 8 have not been reverified in this review. Non-blocking test improvement: freeze the clock in the new future-timestamp regression test so its 5 ms offset cannot expire during setup on a loaded runner, making the regression assertion deterministic.

No interjections or standing orders were delivered. Cost accounting for interrupted paid calls and project model overrides remain out of scope. No implementation files changed during review. The approved implementation edits are still uncommitted.
